summary.text: For balances up to $5,000, ask the bank directly. For higher balances up to $50,000, apply to the Public Trustee.

details.heading: Balances over $5,000
details.body: The Public Trustee’s Office may assist with balances over $5,000 and up to $50,000. Each case is considered separately.

details.heading: Documents you may need
details.body: Common documents include the deceased’s death, birth and marriage certificates, and the beneficiary’s birth certificate and identity card. Other documents may also be needed.

steps.name: Check the balance
steps.text: Find out how much money was in the deceased’s bank account.

steps.name: Ask the bank
steps.text: If the balance is $5,000 or below, approach the bank directly to claim the deceased’s bank money.

steps.name: Apply online
steps.text: If the balance is more than $5,000 and up to $50,000, apply at go.gov.sg/pto for the Public Trustee to administer the deceased’s estate.

steps.name: Choose the service
steps.text: Select “Deceased’s Assets other than Un-nominated CPF Moneys / Baby Bonus / Edusave / PSEA”.

steps.name: Prepare your details
steps.text: Have your Singpass ready. If you cannot apply for a Singpass, apply for a login ID and password through go.gov.sg/pto. Disclose the deceased’s shares, bank savings account, death gratuity, insurance policies and vehicles, if any.
